verdicts.reason: Both 320x50 banners use the same weak structure. The headline sits in a two-line block on the left, a tiny cat cluster is crammed against the right edge, and the middle of the banner is dead purple space, so it reads as the poster shrunk into a corner rather than rearranged. The cats are the main image in the original, but here they are thumbnail-sized and clipped at the bottom. In A they are even smaller and pushed right to the edge. B's cats are slightly larger and easier to read, which makes it marginally better.
